meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show real token usage and estimated savings for the current session. Reads directly from the Claude Code session log — no AI estimation. Triggers on /caveman-stats. Output is injected by the mode-tracker hook; the model itself does not compute the numbers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实时查看本次会话的token用量和节省成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想实时掌握当前会话的token用量与成本节省。
copy.tagline_en: See real token usage and estimated savings for the current session.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to keep an eye on how many tokens your session uses and how much it saves.

howto.what: 装上后，输入 /caveman-stats 会显示当前会话的真实 token 使用量和节省估算，数字直接来自 Claude Code 日志。输出包含规则开销和净节省，若净节省为负会直接说明并建议关闭该功能。
howto.when: 当用户输入斜杠命令 /caveman-stats 时触发。触发后由 hook 直接注入统计输出，模型本身不计算数字。

say.note: 立即显示当前会话的 token 用量和节省估算。
与直接输入命令效果相同。

howto.what_en: After installation, typing /caveman-stats displays real token usage and estimated savings for the current session, read directly from the Claude Code log. Includes estimated rule overhead and net savings; if net is negative, it plainly says so and suggests turning caveman off.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user types /caveman-stats. The hook injects the stats output; the model does not compute anything.

say_en.note: Displays real token usage and savings for this session.
